pull.title: KAFKA-20684 [10/N]: Migrate remaining clients tests to RebalanceListener
pull.body:
PlaintextConsumerAssignorsTest uses the ConsumerRebalanceListener when
it moved to Java in #23708. This was missed during #23108 port.

Migrate it, along with the MockConsumerTest, AsyncKafkaConsumerTest and
ConsumerSubscriptionStateTest cases where the old listener was
incidental.

Tests that cover the deprecated overloads or the 1-arg bridge stay on
the old API until it is removed. A dedicated test for the deprecated
subscribe overloads will be added in KAFKA-21365.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -145,15 +145,15 @@ public void testDurationBasedOffsetReset() {
     public void testRebalanceListener() {
review_comments.body: I guess this test case needs to be kept as it is, since that is what it is meant to test :)

review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -145,15 +145,15 @@ public void testDurationBasedOffsetReset() {
     public void testRebalanceListener() {
review_comments.body: Agreed, we can just keep this around but anno the method with a suppression. And remove at AK5.0
I'm a bit concerned that those deprecated methods will have no tests eventually 😆 So, I opened https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-21365 to add separate test files to keep the test coverage

issue_comments.body: @chia7712  thanks for the review on #23108 ; I just missed the rebase before the Assignors test moved. Could you review this when you get the chance?

commit.message:
KAFKA-20684 [10/N]: Migrate remaining clients tests to RebalanceListener

PlaintextConsumerAssignorsTest came back with a ConsumerRebalanceListener when
it moved to Java in #23708. Migrate it, along with the MockConsumerTest,
AsyncKafkaConsumerTest and SubscriptionStateTest cases where the old listener
was incidental. Tests that cover the deprecated overloads or the 1-arg bridge
stay on the old API until it is removed.
